caller_phone.description: Callback number the caller gave, if different from the number they called from.

issue_description.description: One or two sentences describing what the caller needs.

service_address.description: Street address including ZIP code, if given.

urgency_level.description: emergency = needs help now; high = today; standard = can be scheduled; unqualified = spam, wrong number or out of area.

industry.description: Which business line the call is for.
